continuum_primal: maximize z with integral d_tj q >= z for all j, heat budget, 0<=q<=1
dual_structure: a convex combination of active time kernels minus heat-price times cost; q is thresholded by its sign
theorem: Linear-programming duality proves that a finite multi-time minimax design is bang--bang according to one dual weighted sum of the time kernels minus the heat cost, with fractional mass only on zero-score level sets. Unlike the single-time bathtub order, several threshold bands may occur. The displayed grid solution illustrates the structure but is not a continuum interval optimizer.
